offers_products.reason: Makes Flexitouch Plus and Nimbl pneumatic compression devices and the AffloVest airway clearance vest, manufactured in New Brighton.

offers_services.reason: Patient training, setup and reimbursement support come with the devices; the devices are the main offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients with lymphedema, lipedema, CVI or airway problems get and use the at-home devices, with insurance paying.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Also sells to government (such as the VA) and to healthcare providers and distributors; this is a smaller share.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes mainly from one-time device placements every few years, with some garment replacements.

cyclical_demand.reason: Medically prescribed, insurance-reimbursed therapy for chronic conditions is hard to postpone in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Each compression device or vest is a costly, infrequent purchase for the patient, typically several thousand dollars.

people_delivered.reason: Customers mainly pay for the patented medical devices; staff only provide training and support.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual patients, with insurers paying; sales to large government or enterprise buyers are secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: A device maker with one manufacturing site and an HQ; it runs no fleets, networks or large property base.

notes: Buyer mix is uncertain: patients use the devices, while insurers and Medicare pay.
